guide.title: Welcome to Strategor
guide.subtitle: Strategor transforms your company profile into a complete, board-level strategy. A team of specialized AI agents collaborates for you — and you stay in control at each step. This guide explains what to do, how the app works, and how to read and use each result.

step1.title: Describe
step1.desc: Fill in your company profile (and financials, if you wish).

step2.title: Let analyze
step2.desc: AI agents build the analysis; you validate key steps.

step3.title: Decide & export
step3.desc: Review, adjust, then export your strategy ready to present.

methodo.title: The methodology
methodo.intro: Where a consulting mission takes weeks, Strategor produces a complete initial analysis in a single session. The tool does not replace your judgment: it structures and accelerates your reflection.

experts.title: An expert team
experts.desc: Each AI agent is specialized (PESTEL, competition, finance…) and builds on the work of the previous ones, layer by layer.

data.title: Grounded on data
data.desc: Market analyses are based on recent web research, with sources, and on your documents.

control.title: You stay in control
control.desc: Two validation checkpoints and a module-by-module review: the AI proposes, you decide.

methodo.outro: The analysis is built in phases: Scoping → External analysis → Internal analysis → Diagnostic → Strategy & measurement → Execution, and finally your deliverables.

step1.title: Create a project
step1.todo: From the dashboard, create a new project. One project = one strategic analysis for a company.

step2.title: Fill the profile (onboarding)
step2.todo: Describe your company: activity, sector, territories, target market, objectives, portfolio of offerings.
step2.tip: The more precise you are, the more relevant the analysis. This step conditions everything else.

step3.title: Add your figures and documents (optional)
step3.todo: Enter some financial metrics and import your documents (PDF, Word, Excel). They feed the analysis with your real data.

step4.title: Launch the analysis
step4.todo: Start the analysis. The AI agent team gets to work; progress is displayed in real-time.

step5.title: Validate the hypotheses
step5.todo: First checkpoint: review how the AI understood your company and correct if needed before continuing.
step5.tip: Take this moment seriously: everything else builds on it.

step6.title: Validate the diagnostic
step6.todo: Second checkpoint: validate the diagnostic summary before the AI builds the strategy.

step7.title: Review and validate each module
step7.todo: On the validation page, browse the tabs (one per analysis). For each, you can edit the content, regenerate it, then validate it.
step7.tip: The AI proposes, you decide: adjust anything that needs to be.

step8.title: Export your deliverables
step8.todo: Once everything is validated, export the complete strategy in Word, PDF, PowerPoint, or Excel format.

resultats.title: Understanding your results
resultats.intro: Each analysis has its tab on the validation page. Expand a card to learn what it is, how to read it, and how to use it.

profile.name: Profile & Context
profile.what: The standardized reading of your company: activity, clientele, positioning, strengths and challenges.
profile.read: This is the starting point: a clear summary of who you are.
profile.use: Verify that it matches you — it serves as the foundation for all subsequent analyses.

pestel.name: PESTEL Analysis
pestel.what: Macro factors influencing your market: Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal.
pestel.read: Each factor is scored by its impact, intensity, and horizon (short / medium / long term).
pestel.use: Anticipate changes in your environment and trends to monitor.

competitive.name: Competitive Intelligence
competitive.what: A mapping of your competitors and their positioning.
competitive.read: The map situates your company against its competitors on two key axes.
competitive.use: Identify gaps left open and your possible differentiation.

porter.name: Porter's 5 Forces
porter.what: The structural attractiveness of your market (entrants, suppliers, customers, substitutes, rivalry).
porter.read: Each force is scored by its intensity and justification.
porter.use: Understand where the profitability of your sector is really played.

swot.name: SWOT / TOWS Analysis
swot.what: Your Strengths and Weaknesses (internal), Opportunities and Threats (external), and cross-referenced actions.
swot.read: The matrix prioritizes; TOWS actions cross-reference axes (strengths × opportunities, etc.).
swot.use: Transform the assessment into concrete, prioritized actions.

value_chain.name: Value Chain
value_chain.what: Activities that create value (primary and support).
value_chain.read: Each activity is evaluated by its importance and performance.
value_chain.use: Target the most profitable improvement levers.

diagnostic.name: Consolidated Diagnostic
diagnostic.what: The synthesis of all analyses: position, fault lines, windows of opportunity, urgency level, and executive verdict.
diagnostic.read: This is the heart of the analysis — the overall vision that connects everything.
diagnostic.use: This is the basis of all your strategic decisions. Read it first.

roadmap.name: Strategic Axes & Roadmap
roadmap.what: Your priority axes and their execution plan: initiatives, quick wins, quarterly milestones, resources.
roadmap.read: A roadmap over ~18 months, structured by axis.
roadmap.use: Your action plan: where to start and in what order.

bcg.name: BCG Matrix
bcg.what: The positioning of your business portfolio (market growth × relative market share).
bcg.read: Four quadrants: Stars, Cash cows, Question marks, Dogs.
bcg.use: Decide where to invest, maintain, harvest, or divest.

kpi.name: KPIs & Dashboard
kpi.what: Indicators to track, organized (financial, customer, process, learning), with targets and benchmarks.
kpi.read: A 'north star' metric and a balanced scorecard.
kpi.use: Drive execution and measure your progress over time.

change.name: Change Management
change.what: The human dimension of implementation: stakeholders, RACI matrix, communication plan, resistance.
change.read: Who does what, who to communicate to, what adoption risks.
change.use: Put all the chances on your side for a successful execution.

risk.name: Risk Register
risk.what: Major risks identified, assessed, and accompanied by mitigation measures.
risk.read: Each risk is scored (probability × impact) with a plan.
risk.use: Anticipate and prepare your responses before problems arise.

finance.name: Financial Analysis & Scenarios
finance.what: Numerical projections and scenarios (sensitivity to key variables).
finance.read: Multiple scenarios to test the robustness of the strategy.
finance.use: Quantify your decisions and evaluate their strength against uncertainties.

consistency.name: Consistency Check
consistency.what: An automatic review that detects inconsistencies between different analyses.
consistency.read: The list of points to check, with their severity.
consistency.use: Make your report reliable before presenting it to a committee or an investor.

cta.title: Ready to build your strategy?
cta.desc: Create a project and let yourself be guided.

tip1.title: Be precise right from onboarding
tip1.desc: The quality of the analysis depends directly on the quality of what you describe.

tip2.title: Add your real data
tip2.desc: Financial indicators and documents make the analysis much more concrete.

tip3.title: Pay attention to checkpoints
tip3.desc: Validating hypotheses and then the diagnostic prevents errors from propagating.

tip4.title: Edit without hesitation
tip4.desc: You know your company better than the AI does: correct, specify, rephrase.

tip5.title: Regenerate if needed
tip5.desc: A module doesn't suit you? Relaunch it to get a new proposal.

tip6.title: Export at the end
tip6.desc: When everything is validated, export the strategy in the format of your choice.
